subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should terminal-less EOF fail closed for every provider using the shared Responses transport, and should this PR be the canonical implementation instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133?
rationale: The bug fix is sound for the OpenAI Responses contract, but the shared parser also serves Azure, ChatGPT Responses, and compatible proxies whose existing upgrade behavior is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Adopt this shared fix
options.body: Require documented terminal events across all shared Responses variants, add focused provider-variant compatibility coverage, and use this proof-positive mergeable branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Scope strict termination
options.body: Apply fail-closed EOF only to provider variants whose terminal-event contract is confirmed, preserving current behavior for other compatible endpoints.

options.title: Choose the competing branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 after resolving its conflicts and bringing its real behavior proof and tool-use coverage to the same standard.

recommendation.title: Adopt this shared fix
recommendation.body: Require documented terminal events across all shared Responses variants, add focused provider-variant compatibility coverage, and use this proof-positive mergeable branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This cross-provider compatibility and canonical-branch choice needs repository-level agent-runtime ownership.
